dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent and sharp white margins along the edges of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers against a dark gray body.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A rectangular, high-contrast area of dense, fine dark-on-pale speckling across the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct and linear; clear transition from the uniform gray-brown crown to the highly patterned, scalloped mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Robust, thick pale-colored bill with a slightly hooked tip and a prominent dark post-ocular stripe.
